title: RLC bearer release
text: 1 >  for each logicalChannelIdentity/LogicalChannelIdentityExt value included in the rlc-BearerToReleaseList/rlc- BearerToReleaseListExt that is part of the current UE configuration within the same cell group (LCH release);   or
1 >  for each logicalChannelIdentity value that is to be released as the result of an SCG release according to 5.3.5.4:
2 >  release the RLC entity or entities as specified in TS 38.322 , clause 5.1.3;
